Doctor: Hello. Could you tell me your age and gender, and what brings you in today?
Patient: Hello. I'm 43 years old, and I'm here because I hurt the top part of my right leg. I was bowling, and I accidentally hit my leg with the ball instead of the lane, and then I fell. It's been sore ever since.
Doctor: Could you please provide your gender and describe the nature of the pain in your right leg, including when it started and if there is any swelling, bruising, or difficulty moving the leg?
Patient: I'm female. The pain started when I hit my leg with the bowling ball, and it's been sore ever since. There's a little bruising on the back side of my leg, and it's swollen a little, but not too much. It's hard to walk on it, and I'm careful not to put too much weight on it.
Doctor: Have you experienced any numbness, tingling, or weakness in your right leg since the injury?
Patient: No, I haven't had any numbness, tingling, or weakness in my right leg since the injury. It's just sore and bruised, and I'm careful not to put too much weight on it.
Doctor: Have you had any prior injuries or surgeries to your right leg, and do you have any known medical conditions such as diabetes, osteoporosis, or blood clotting disorders?
Patient: No, I haven't had any prior injuries or surgeries to my right leg. I do have a history of atopic eczema, and I had a colectomy in the past due to diverticulitis, but that was on my abdomen, not my leg. I don't have diabetes, osteoporosis, or any blood clotting disorders that I'm aware of.
Doctor: Could you describe the exact location of the pain on your right leg and whether you've noticed any deformity or instability in the area?
Patient: The pain is on the top part of my right leg, more on the side. I don't think there's any deformity or instability, just soreness and bruising. It's not bent or out of place, just hurts when I touch it or try to walk on it.
Doctor: Could you describe any swelling, bruising, or changes in skin color around the injured area, and have you experienced any numbness, tingling, or weakness in your right leg?
Patient: There's a little bruising on the back side of my leg, and it's swollen a little, but not too much. The skin looks normal, no numbness, tingling, or weakness in my right leg. It's just sore and bruised, and I'm careful not to put too much weight on it.
Doctor: Can you describe the type of pain you're experiencing in your right leg? For example, is it sharp, dull, throbbing, or aching?
Patient: The pain is more of a throbbing and aching feeling, especially when I put weight on it or touch it. It's not sharp, just a constant soreness that's pretty uncomfortable.
Doctor: Have you had any imaging studies, such as X-rays or an MRI, done for this injury?
Patient: No, I haven't had any imaging studies done for this injury yet. The doctor just mentioned looking at an X-ray, and it came back normal, but I haven't had one done myself before today.
Doctor: Have you experienced any numbness, tingling, or weakness in your right leg since the injury, and has the pain worsened with any specific activity?
Patient: No, I haven't experienced any numbness, tingling, or weakness in my right leg since the injury. The pain hasn't really worsened with any specific activity other than walking on it or touching it, which makes it sore. It's just been a constant ache, especially when I try to put weight on it.
Doctor: Could you please provide the date of the X-ray and confirm whether it was performed at a facility that has access to the imaging results? Additionally, have you had any follow-up imaging or evaluations since the X-ray?
